about_the_game:
Booklet is the only empty storybook in all of the Grand Library! Journey alongside them as they wrestle with feelings of unbelonging while striving to find their own story in this 3D puzzle platformer.

Emotional Narrative

Booklet’s dealing with some big feelings! Being the only storybook in the Grand Library without a story is pretty isolating, and it would be terribly lonely too if not for the Narrator, Booklet’s first and endlessly inspiriting friend. But the Narrator isn’t the only influential figure you’ll encounter–each one will shape the trajectory of Booklet’s self-discovery, for better or for worse.

Puzzling Gameplay

Every section of the Grand Library you explore will empower Booklet with an ability they can use to overcome thematic puzzles and conflicts. With your help, they’ll uncover the secrets of classic genres like Fantasy, Science Fiction, and Noir by platforming through intricate, multi-leveled set pieces brought to life by the library’s magic.
